about_the_game:
This game takes place the day after the events of "My Mentally Unstable Streamer Girlfriend Is an Abusive Sadist"

Your girlfriend, Sachiko, is rapidly rising the ranks of Streamerly, the most popular streamer site in the world. However, the current number 1 streamer, Rivas, sabotages Sachiko by creating a facesitting giveaway, and in order to enter her facesitting giveaway, you can't be following Sachiko, resulting in Sachiko losing a ton of followers and halting her rise to the top. If your actions are discovered, your loyalties will be tested, and just like that, the facesitting war between your girlfriend and her rival has begun.
